about: Rows read from the source text (arXiv HTML parsed locally, or pypdf text) of Chen & Heyl (Nat. Phys. 20, 1476), Rende et al. (Commun. Phys. 7, 260), Nutakki, Shokry & Vicentini (Phys. Rev. Research 7, 043099), Gu et al. (arXiv:2604.25775; Nat. Commun. 17, 7838), Loehr & Clark (arXiv:2510.26906) and arXiv:2507.01856. Spin energies printed as S.S per site are stored as Pauli totals (x 4N); Hubbard energies per site as totals (x N). Row notes cite this file by its earlier form, scripts/add_literature.mjs (git history).
